name: St. James Santee Parish Church (Wambaw)
record_repository: South Carolina Historical Society, collection 0148.00; parish register 1758–1789 transcriptions 0148.01(M)02.08–09
note: [Santee] Wambaw / Old Brick Church, built 1768 on King’s Highway (Old Georgetown Road). Parish established 1706. Coordinates identify the nearby historical marker, not a surveyed building center. Earlier parish entries precede this building and may relate to Echaw or other sites; the 1890 McClellanville chapel is separate. Recorded people include baptism subjects, parents, sponsors and burials, not an attendance roll. Individual residences and most event locations remain unlocated. No simultaneous congregation assembly is asserted.
